#Cashier.Base.daily
Bot: Where are we?
You: It’s a bowling alley. I didn’t even know these were still around.
Melissa: The owners are ancient, I doubt they even know what the internet is. Thus, you won’t find this place on any app.
You: How did you find it then?
Melissa: I used to come here with my coworkers. They were very insistent so it was easier to just come.
You: Did you have fun?
Melissa: …
You: Even a little?
Melissa: Did any of you ever bowl? 
You: No, I don’t think so.
Melissa: Let me explain the rules then.
Melissa: You need to wear special bowling shoes. You can borrow some on the left.
Melissa: The point of the game is to strike every pin at the end of the bowling lane with a bowling ball.
Melissa: There are other rules like the one that says that you can’t cross the foul line, but let’s leave it for later. You will learn as we play.
You: Sounds good to me.
You: Were you winning with your coworkers?
#bot.Expression.happy
Melissa: No, I was average.
Bot: I bet I will be better then!
Melissa: We will see…
